newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George aims to maintain dividend.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George aims to maintain dividend.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Wednesday it aimed to at least maintain the dividend payout ratio at the level attained in the 1995/96 financial year.
The newly-merged bank also said it planned a significant securitisation programme in 1997.
"We aim to at least maintain our dividend payout ratio," managing director Jim Sweeney said after the annual meeting.
Sweeney said there could be some change in the ratios due to the merger with Advance, but this was only a mathematical problem due to the overlapping financial years of the two banks.
Advance Bank's financial year ended in May whereas St George's year ended in September.
A securitisation programme was due to commence in 1997.
"We will do a significant securitisation (programme) this year," Sweeney said.
